title.zh: 高斯变换逐层保留统一有界性
title.en: Preserve the uniform bound through each Gaussian transform

given.zh: 选 K 使所有 x 满足 |f(x)|≤K，因此 K≥0。每个离散模式 Pₙ(f,q) 都由有限次 G_{s,d} 递归作用于 f 后在 0 处取值得到。
given.en: Choose K with |f(x)|≤K for all x, so K≥0. Each discrete pattern Pₙ(f,q) is obtained by finitely many transforms G_{s,d} applied to f, then evaluated at 0.

claim.zh: 若 |U|≤K，则 |G_{s,d}U|≤K；沿有限递归归纳，得到对所有 q,n 都有 |Pₙ(f,q)|≤K。
claim.en: If |U|≤K, then |G_{s,d}U|≤K. Induction through the finite recursion gives |Pₙ(f,q)|≤K for every q and n.

reason.zh: 高斯测度的总质量为一，对上下常数取积分不改变它们的数值。
reason.en: The Gaussian measure has total mass one, so integrating the bounding constants leaves them unchanged.

reason.zh: |U|≤K 给出 |dU|≤|d|K，再用指数函数单调性；在可测分支中，期望仍位于同一正区间。
reason.en: The bound |U|≤K gives |dU|≤|d|K, then monotonicity of exp gives the displayed bounds. In the measurable branch, the expectation stays in this positive interval.

reason.zh: 对正期望取单调的 log，再除以 |d|>0；源码另处理积分的非可测分支，此时定义值为 0，仍满足同一界。
reason.en: Take the monotone logarithm of the positive expectation and divide by |d|>0. The source also handles the nonmeasurable-integral branch: its defined value is zero and satisfies the same bound.

statement.zh: 每一层把 [−K,K] 送回自身 ⇒ |Pₙ(f,q)|≤K，对全部 n,q 成立。
statement.en: Every layer maps [−K,K] back into itself, hence |Pₙ(f,q)|≤K for all n,q.

reason.zh: 从 |f|≤K 出发对有限 foldr 列表归纳；不论路径产生多少层、采用哪些参数，归纳上界都不变。
reason.en: Induct over the finite foldr list starting with |f|≤K. The bound is unchanged by the number of layers or the parameters produced by the path.

title.zh: 分别处理序列收敛与回退值
title.en: Handle convergence and the fallback value separately

given.zh: P_f(q) 使用 Filter.limUnder。令 c 为该定义在序列不收敛时采用的固定实数；定义 L=min(−K,c)，U=max(K,c)。
given.en: P_f(q) uses Filter.limUnder. Let c be its fixed real fallback for a sequence with no limit. Put L=min(−K,c) and U=max(K,c).

claim.zh: 对每条路径 q，L≤P_f(q)≤U；这里 L、U 都是与 q 无关的有限实数。
claim.en: For every path q, L≤P_f(q)≤U, with finite real L and U independent of q.

statement.zh: 若存在 x 使 Pₙ(f,q)→x，则 −K≤x≤K，且 P_f(q)=x。
statement.en: If Pₙ(f,q)→x for some x, then −K≤x≤K and P_f(q)=x.

reason.zh: 所有项的闭区间界随极限保留；有极限时 limUnder 等于该极限。
reason.en: Closed interval bounds pass to the limit, and limUnder equals that limit when it exists.

statement.zh: 若不存在极限，则 P_f(q)=c，其中 c=Classical.choice(Nonempty ℝ) 固定不变。
statement.en: If no limit exists, P_f(q)=c, where c=Classical.choice(Nonempty ℝ) is fixed.

reason.zh: 这是当前 limUnder 在无极限分支的定义；c 与 q 无关，但这里不把它假定为零。
reason.en: This is the current definition of limUnder in its no-limit branch. The value is independent of q and is not assumed to be zero.

reason.zh: 第一分支落在 [−K,K]，第二分支等于 c；扩大端点到 L、U 就同时覆盖两种情形。
reason.en: The first branch lies in [−K,K] and the second equals c. Enlarging the endpoints to L,U covers both cases.

title.zh: 把零场放入上确界，得到熵项非负
title.en: Insert the zero field into the supremum to bound entropy below

given.zh: S(q)=sup_h[R(h)+(1/2)∫h(u)q(u)du]，上确界遍历合法的非负单调场阶梯函数。
given.en: S(q)=sup_h[R(h)+(1/2)∫h(u)q(u)du], over admissible nonnegative monotone field steps.

claim.zh: 对每个 q，都有 S(q)≥0。于是 αP_f(q)+S(q)≥αL。
claim.en: For every q, S(q)≥0, and consequently αP_f(q)+S(q)≥αL.

statement.zh: 取只有一个分段、场值为 0 的 h₀；则 stepFunction(h₀)=0，所有方差增量为 0。
statement.en: Choose the one-level field h₀ of value zero. Then stepFunction(h₀)=0 and all variance increments vanish.

reason.zh: 零场非负且单调，满足 FieldStep 的要求，因而可作为定义熵项的合法候选。
reason.en: The zero field is nonnegative and monotone, so it satisfies FieldStep and is an admissible candidate for the entropy supremum.

reason.zh: 零方差与零参数的递归不改变终端函数在 0 的值，积分项也恒为零；上确界不小于这个候选。
reason.en: The zero-variance, zero-parameter recursion retains the terminal value at zero, and the integral vanishes. The supremum is at least this candidate.

reason.zh: α≥0 使乘法保持 P_f(q)≥L 的方向；再加上非负熵项即可得到与 q 无关的下界。
reason.en: Since α≥0, multiplication preserves P_f(q)≥L. Adding the nonnegative entropy gives a lower bound independent of q.

title.zh: 逐层累计高斯代价，再与终端惩罚抵消
title.en: Accumulate Gaussian costs and cancel the terminal penalty

given.zh: 对任意场 h，设最后场值为 W≥0。方差增量 sᵢ≥0 且 Σsᵢ=W，分割点 dᵢ∈[0,1]；终端函数为 log cosh(x)−W/2。
given.en: For a field h, let its final value be W≥0. Its variance increments satisfy sᵢ≥0 and Σsᵢ=W, and its partition values satisfy dᵢ∈[0,1]. The terminal function is log cosh(x)−W/2.

claim.zh: 每层最多增加 sᵢ/2，故整个场递归满足 R(h)≤log cosh(0)−W/2+Σsᵢ/2=0。
claim.en: Each layer adds at most sᵢ/2, so the full recursion satisfies R(h)≤log cosh(0)−W/2+Σsᵢ/2=0.

reason.zh: 把 cosh 写成两个指数之和的一半，分别用 t=√s 与 t=−√s 的高斯矩母函数。这里 s≥0，有限的指数矩也保证 cosh 项可积。
reason.en: Write cosh as half the sum of two exponentials and use the Gaussian moment-generating function at t=√s and t=−√s, with s≥0. These finite exponential moments also ensure integrability of the cosh term.

reason.zh: 正数上的 t↦tᵈ 为凹函数，Jensen 不等式给出此方向；再取 log/d，得到上界 log cosh x+s/2。
reason.en: The function t↦tᵈ is concave on positive reals, so Jensen gives this direction. Taking log/d yields the bound log cosh x+s/2.

statement.zh: d=0 时，E[log cosh(Y)]≤log E[cosh(Y)]=log cosh x+s/2。
statement.en: For d=0, E[log cosh(Y)]≤log E[cosh(Y)]=log cosh x+s/2.

reason.zh: 此时直接用 log 的凹性。加上已有的常数 b 后，两种参数情形都给 G_{s,d}U≤log cosh+b+s/2。
reason.en: Use concavity of log directly. Including the existing constant b gives G_{s,d}U≤log cosh+b+s/2 in both parameter cases.

reason.zh: FieldStep 的非负单调性保证每个 sᵢ≥0；有限差分逐项抵消，只留下末值 W。分割点同时保证 0≤dᵢ≤1。
reason.en: Nonnegativity and monotonicity of FieldStep give sᵢ≥0. The finite differences telescope to W, and the partition gives 0≤dᵢ≤1.

reason.zh: 每层的 sᵢ/2 上界相加，恰与终端惩罚 W/2 抵消。终端函数可测且不低于 −W/2；源码归纳同时保留可测性和下界，它们与 cosh 上界一起保证每层期望及 Jensen 所需的可积性。
reason.en: The layer bounds sᵢ/2 add and exactly cancel the terminal penalty W/2. The terminal function is measurable and bounded below by −W/2. The source induction retains measurability and this lower bound; together with the cosh upper bound they ensure the integrability needed for each expectation and Jensen step.

title.zh: 零路径给出一个有限候选值
title.en: Use the zero path as a finite competitor

given.zh: 令 q₀(u)=0，它满足路径单调性及 0≤q₀≤1。已知任意 q 的 S(q)≥0，以及任意场 h 的 R(h)≤0。
given.en: Let q₀(u)=0, an admissible monotone path with values in [0,1]. We have S(q)≥0 for every q and R(h)≤0 for every field h.

claim.zh: S(q₀)=0；因此 αP_f(q₀)+S(q₀)=αP_f(q₀)≤αU，是一个有限的变分候选值。
claim.en: S(q₀)=0. Hence αP_f(q₀)+S(q₀)=αP_f(q₀)≤αU is a finite variational candidate.

reason.zh: 零函数满足单调性和 [0,1] 取值要求，其等价类代表几乎处处为零，所以积分消失。
reason.en: The zero function is monotone with values in [0,1], and its equivalence-class representative is zero almost everywhere, making the integral vanish.

statement.en: S(q₀)=sup_h R(h)≤0, while S(q₀)≥0; hence S(q₀)=0.

reason.zh: 上界使用任意 h 的场递归界，下界使用零场候选。两条证明支线在这个零路径处汇合。
reason.en: The upper bound uses the field-recursion estimate for every h; the lower bound uses the zero-field candidate. These branches meet at the zero path.

reason.zh: P_f(q₀)≤U 且 α≥0，所以该合法路径提供一个具有有限上界的候选值。
reason.en: The bound P_f(q₀)≤U and α≥0 give a finite upper bound for this admissible candidate.

title.zh: 用两侧实数界排除扩展无穷
title.en: Exclude both extended infinities using real bounds

given.zh: 每个候选值都至少为 αL，而零路径的候选值至多为 αU；L=min(−K,c)，U=max(K,c)。
given.en: Every candidate is at least αL, and the zero-path candidate is at most αU, where L=min(−K,c) and U=max(K,c).

claim.zh: 在扩展实数中有 αL≤V≤αU，因此存在 p∈ℝ，使 V=(p:EReal)。
claim.en: In the extended reals, αL≤V≤αU. Therefore there exists p∈ℝ with V=(p:EReal).

statement.en: For all q, αL≤αP_f(q)+S(q), so αL≤inf_q[αP_f(q)+S(q)]=V.

reason.zh: 共同下界不依赖 q，因此按下确界的定义仍是 V 的下界，排除 V=−∞。
reason.en: The common bound is independent of q and hence remains a lower bound of the infimum, excluding V=−∞.

reason.zh: 下确界不大于任一候选，特别是不大于已构造的零路径候选；有限实数 αU 因而排除 V=+∞。
reason.en: An infimum is no greater than any candidate, including the zero-path candidate. The finite real αU therefore excludes V=+∞.

statement.zh: V≠−∞ 且 V≠+∞ ⇒ V=(V.toReal:EReal)；取 p=V.toReal。
statement.en: V≠−∞ and V≠+∞ imply V=(V.toReal:EReal); take p=V.toReal.

reason.zh: 扩展实数去掉两端后恰好是嵌入的实数。这里证明的是有限性，未额外断言下确界被某条路径达到。
reason.en: An extended real different from both infinities is an embedded real. This proves finiteness without additionally claiming that a path attains the infimum.
